def factor_nonlinear_vp_vol_gated(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    price_chg = df_copy["close"] - df_copy["close"].shift(5)
    volume_chg = df_copy["volume"] - df_copy["volume"].shift(5)
    raw_interaction = price_chg * volume_chg
    smoothed = raw_interaction.ewm(span=10, min_periods=10).mean()
    _, _, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=20)
    vol_gate = np.clip(vol_ratio, 0.5, 2.0)
    factor = smoothed * vol_gate
    df_copy["factor_nonlinear_vp_vol_gated"] = factor
    return df_copy["factor_nonlinear_vp_vol_gated"]
description: Crossover that preserves parent1's core mechanism of volume-confirmed price moves via product of short-term changes, smoothed with EMA.
